_about: Beta 14: the built-in image search services (right-click an image, Search for this image; Settings, Search, Search images with). THE ONE PLACE TO UPDATE when a service changes its entry points. `byAddress`: where the service is opened with the picture's public https address (%s, percent-encoded); null when its by-address link no longer lands on results. `upload`: how the picture's bytes are sent when it cannot go by address (a blob: or data: picture, one behind a login, on the local network, with a signed address): the multipart `field`, `as` 'file' or 'base64', and how the answer becomes a results address: `result` 'redirect' (the answer redirects to it) or 'json' (the answer names the picture, `resultUrl` takes its place at %s from `jsonPath`). null when no upload entry point is known to work. `hosts`: the only hosts a results address may have. Every entry was fetched live on `checked` with a plain synthetic picture; `note` says what was seen.

services.name: Google Lens
services.note: by address: 303 to a google.com/search results page; upload: 303 to a results page

services.name: TinEye
services.note: by address: 200; upload: POST /search answers 405 (the site is a web app now) and its upload endpoint could not be found from the test network, so a picture that needs an upload gets a notice

services.name: Yandex
services.note: by address: 200; upload: JSON naming the stored picture (originalImageUrl), which the by-address form takes

services.name: Bing
services.note: by address: every form tried (imgurl:, searchbyimage) lands on the Images home page, not on results, so Bing always goes by upload; upload: 302 to a results page
